data.title: Bitcoin Miner HIVE Eyes $45 Million in Annual Revenue From AI Deal
data.description: The Bitcoin miner says its Boden facility could generate $45 million annually, but a June letter of intent remains nonbinding as executives negotiate financing and customer protections for the project.
